personality_one_liner: A trustworthy, refined, and frictionless scheduling experience built on warm stone tones and sage green to balance financial security with approachable wellness.

spacing.rule: Use iOS-native spacing rhythms. Ensure generous vertical breathing room and minimum 56pt tappable height for lists. Use safe-area paddings at all screen roots.

do's: Use on bottom tab bar when content scrolls behind
Use on sticky bottom pay bar in checkout screens
Use on sticky headers over scrolling content
Pair with a translucent tinted base (≥70% of surface) underneath to guarantee text readability
dont's: Never apply to form fields, body text regions, or dense list rows
Do not use on low-end Android (fallback to solid surfaceSecondary)

screens.name: Welcome
screens.purpose: First entry point containing the Google Sign-In button and communicating trust.
screens.layout: Full-bleed background image with a vertical gradient scrim (transparent to surfaceInverse at bottom). A floating 'surfaceSecondary' card at the bottom holds the logo, value prop text, and a large 'Sign in with Google' button (using Ionicons logo-google).

screens.name: RoleSelection
screens.purpose: A one-time setup screen post-login to branch the app into Client or Professional mode.
screens.layout: Clean top header. Two large, equal-sized touchable cards stacked vertically. Each card has an icon (e.g., 'person' vs 'briefcase'), a title, and a short description. A sticky 'Continue' CTA sits at the bottom inside a KeyboardAvoidingView/SafeArea.

screens.name: ClientHome
screens.purpose: Client dashboard showing upcoming appointments and service search.

states.empty: Empty state illustration of a clean desk with 'No upcoming appointments. Book your next session.'
states.error: Failed to load appointments message with retry CTA

screens.layout: Header with user greeting. A prominent 'Next Appointment' card (glassmorphism overlay if over an image, or surfaceSecondary card) with status of the payment hold. Below, a horizontal scrolling list of 'Suggested Professionals' or categories.

screens.name: ProfessionalHome
screens.purpose: Professional dashboard showing daily agenda and pending attendance confirmations.

states.empty: Empty state illustration of a clean desk indicating a free schedule today.
states.error: Failed to load agenda message with retry

screens.layout: Top section shows an active horizontal date selector (agenda view). The main body is a vertical list of the day's appointments. Appointments needing action (after time has passed) are highlighted with a 'brandTertiary' background to prompt attendance confirmation.

screens.name: AppointmentActionSheet
screens.purpose: Professional view to confirm if the client attended or no-showed.

states.loading: Spinner on action buttons during API call

screens.layout: Bottom sheet presentation. Shows client details, total hold amount. Features two prominent buttons: Primary 'Client Attended (Capture 100%)' and Secondary/Warning 'No-Show (Capture Fee)'. Includes a countdown text showing when the hold naturally expires.

screens.name: ScheduleCheckout
screens.purpose: Client flow to finalize booking and pre-authorize the payment hold.

states.error: Payment failed state with 'Retry Payment' button

screens.layout: Vertical scroll listing service details, selected date/time, and a clear price breakdown (Total vs No-Show Fee). The screen has a fixed sticky bottom pay bar (glassmorphism) with a 'Pre-authorize $XX.XX' primary button. Ensures users don't have to scroll to act.

screens.name: AppointmentDetail
screens.purpose: Detailed view of an appointment showing the specific lifecycle of the payment hold.
screens.layout: Hero section with professional's image and a gradient scrim. Below, the appointment time and location. A dedicated 'Payment Status' card (surfaceSecondary) clearly indicates the hold status (Authorized / Captured / Expired) using a colored status badge.

welcome_bg.alt: Abstract soft blurred shapes in warm off-white and beige

professional_hero.alt: Professional therapist taking notes during a session

empty_calendar.alt: Minimalist bright desk with a closed laptop and calendar

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: Use the '1 iOS-Native Clean' personality guidelines. Adhere strictly to the color palette. No blues, purples, or indigos are allowed; rely on the provided sage green and warm stone tones.
Implement a dynamic routing structure based on the user's role (Client vs Professional). Once the role is selected, the app should serve the appropriate tab navigator.
For the ScheduleCheckout screen, ensure the 'Pre-authorize' button is placed inside a sticky bottom container (outside the ScrollView) with a glass effect, so it remains accessible at all times.

When rendering images (like the Welcome background or Professional hero image), ALWAYS use a vertical gradient scrim (from transparent to surfaceInverse at the bottom) between the image and any overlay text to guarantee readability.
Add subtle haptic feedback (using expo-haptics) to the role selection cards, the 'Pre-authorize' button, and the 'Confirm Attendance' actions in the Professional's action sheet.
For the AppointmentActionSheet, ensure the destructive 'No-Show' action has sufficient friction (e.g., an Alert confirmation) before executing, as it captures funds.
